topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I moved slowly through the garden, my steps lighter than the whisper of the breeze. The spot where I used to sit, under the tree I planted as a child, now lay bare. The stump was a stark circle, a full stop where stories and laughter used to bloom. I traced the rough edge with my fingers, each splinter a trace of time lost. The air, once filled with the scent of leaves and blossoms, now felt thin, as if the oxygen had been cut away with the branches. I lingered, not knowing what else to do, hoping the ground might yield some forgotten seed, a promise of what once was.
